observations.body: Children are told to obey parents in the Lord; the honor command is cited as the first commandment with promise of well-being and long life.
observations.label: The parent command is addressed to children in Christ

observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.

payload.posture: Read Ephesians 6:1–3 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The parent command is addressed to children in Christ belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
